test_cases.name: runtime_exception
test_cases.input: My Python script crashes with a TypeError when I pass a None value to a function that expects a string. Help me debug it.
assertions: Classifies the symptom as a crash/exception
Asks for or inspects the stack trace and inputs
Suggests a minimal reproduction and verification step before fixing

test_cases.name: failing_unit_test
test_cases.input: This unit test started failing after the last commit. It used to pass. The assertion is comparing two lists that should be equal.
assertions: Checks recent changes and reproduction steps
Gathers evidence from the test failure message
Verifies the fix by re-running the specific test

test_cases.name: unexpected_output
test_cases.input: The API returns the wrong total price for a shopping cart. It works for single items but fails when there are discounts.
assertions: Reduces to a minimal input that shows the wrong total
Confirms root cause with an experiment before applying a fix
